stem.text: A student carries out a semi-quantitative test with Benedict’s solution.
Which statement about this procedure is correct?

A.text: It detects only the presence or absence of glucose.

B.text: It provides an indication of relative reducing sugar concentrations.

C.text: The precipitate needs to be filtered, dried and weighed to give the reducing sugar concentration.

D.text: A colorimeter needs to be used to determine the glucose concentration.
